gen-fs-expose-gf-stack-sans-notch: Expose packs its caps and lowercase tight, with hardly a pause between them. Stack Sans Notch is a plain sans with rod-straight strokes and big-bodied lowercase you can see right into.
gen-fs-expose-gf-stack-sans-text: Expose crowds its capitals and lowercase into a compressed, striking line, hardly stopping for breath. Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like stroke with generous openings.
gen-fs-expose-gf-sulphur-point: Hardly any gap separates the lowercase from the caps in Expose, so its headings run tight and refined. And Sulphur Point answers that with a flat marker-like sans line and bulky, open letters that loosen everything up.
gen-fs-expose-gf-tiktok-sans: Expose pulls its lowercase right up against the capitals, giving headings a striking, compressed cadence. But TikTok Sans, a plain sans with tall lowercase and a spacious c, spreads out where the heading tightens.
gen-fs-expose-gf-ubuntu-sans: Contemporary is the feeling Ubuntu Sans gives off, with tubular strokes like bent copper pipe and lowercase eyes as big as washers. And its curves lift off before closing, so a long passage reads with an easy, open rhythm, while Expose stays compressed above.
gen-fs-expose-gf-vend-sans: Neutral on the surface, Vend Sans is drawn as if with a ruler. Its wide, unclosed curves and tall x-height carry the pair, a plain sans that shows no brush-style swell next to Expose's squeezed, refined caps.
gen-fs-expose-gf-yaldevi: Expose is compressed and striking, with caps and lowercase nearly level. Yaldevi gives it room underneath, a sans with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, so the page loosens after the tight heading.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-clash-grotesk: Round letters drawn like bent wire make Kohinoor Zerone instantly recognizable. Clash Grotesk, a plain sans with no thick-and-thin modulation, keeps a longer passage approachable and made for short stretches of reading.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-gf-orbit: Kohinoor Zerone draws precise round letters like bent wire, with a contemporary look. Orbit, a plain sans, matches that rope-like consistency yet lets each character float apart, with curves that stop short of closing.
gen-fs-kohinoor-zerone-gf-science-gothic: Bent-wire roundness is what stands out in Kohinoor Zerone. Its precise display shapes do the attention-grabbing, while Science Gothic, a sans-serif with far-apart stroke ends and no thick and thin parts, lets you read one letter at a time.
